commitment_contract.proposal: A policy resolves a proposed stop from its current PolicyView.
commitment_contract.decision: REQUESTED and PIT_PLANNED record a pending instruction. The scheduled entry may be retimed.
commitment_contract.approach: APPROACHING_PIT_ENTRY is a forecast of entry, subject to physical rescheduling.
commitment_contract.revision: P2 may revise a neutralization request on a committed GREEN_RELEASE while the car stays on track and strictly before its current geometric entry line. It can revise once.
commitment_contract.irreversible: The geometric pit-entry line is the revision deadline. PIT_ENTRY_COMMITTED records the actual route transition. Simultaneous race control is processed first but the geometric guard disallows cancellation at equality.
commitment_contract.replacement: A revised instruction has a distinct decision ID. Only service completion consumes a set.
commitment_contract.latency: The archived scripts provide committed event clocks. Late availability relative to the simulation event is rejected by the S6-A input gate. No empirical latency model is used.
commitment_contract.closure: Red phases and unsupported geometry use existing scheduler gates. No independent pit closure model.
commitment_contract.receding_scope: One bounded in-run plan revision on newly observed GREEN. No rewind or future-query optimizer.
